description: Use this skill whenever code can fail and the caller has to find out — a write to disk or storage, an external call, a catch block, an endpoint that returns a body, a fetcher, a renderer, a chart that reduces an array — and whenever the user says something "silently did nothing", data disappeared without an error, a request returned 200 but the page is empty, a job later died on something that was reported as accepted, or a retry loop never fires. It covers the two halves of the same bug: an ignored return value, and a success status served over a failure. It also covers the decision trace, for when nobody can reconstruct why a user got the outcome they got. Do not use it for what goes inside a log line (padosoft-logging-discipline) or for retry and timeout policy.
